projects.name: GPBMT CRM — Diocese Management System
projects.description: Full-stack AI-Integrated Project (Jan 2026 - May 2026) — Comprehensive finance, HR, and administrative management system for Buôn Ma Thuột Diocese. Manages parishes/parishioners, multi-fund finance (11 fund types across 3 groups) with transaction approval workflows, HR/payroll auto-transactions, asset leasing contracts, multi-currency donor tracking, full audit logs, and BI reporting (Excel/PDF export).
bullets: Architected a full layered system: Next.js API Routes → Middleware → Service Layer → Mongoose Models, built and delivered from scratch in ~4 months.
Implemented custom JWT authentication from scratch (access token 1h + refresh token 7d, httpOnly cookies, bcryptjs) — including a live migration away from NextAuth mid-project.
Designed 5-role RBAC system (SuperAdmin, DioceseManager, ParishPriest, ParishAccountant, Viewer) with fine-grained permission control across all modules.
Built multi-currency financial tracking, transaction approval workflows, payroll auto-generation, and comprehensive audit logs for full financial accountability.
Delivered structured development process: PRD documentation, epic-based story planning, architecture docs, Vitest unit/integration API tests, and GitLab CI/CD with Docker Swarm (multi-stage Alpine).

projects.name: HD Booking App — Multi-tenant SaaS Booking Platform

bullets: Supported a multi-tenant domain-based architecture with 3 route groups (marketplace / merchant / tenant), handling SSR/SSG + JSON-LD structured data for SEO-optimized service and store pages.
Led authentication security upgrade: migrated from localStorage token storage to HttpOnly cookie + in-memory token pattern, significantly reducing XSS attack surface.
